raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Prenatal Strength Programme (Moderate)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength safely through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body & Core - Week 1":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Standing dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine hip flexor stretch 60s
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body & Core - Week 2":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Resistance band face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest opener stretch 60s
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body & Core - Week 3":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Standing dumbbell shoulder press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 60s
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body & Core - Week 4":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Band pull apart 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat-cow flow 60s
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body & Core - Week 5":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift with kettlebell 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat (bodyweight or light dumbbells) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Glute bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press (anti-rotation) 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 60s
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body & Core - Week 6":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift with kettlebell 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Split squat (DB) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Hip thrust 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute stretch 60s
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body & Core - Week 7":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Hip thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Anti-rotation carry 3x20s each side
        cooldown:
          quad stretch 60s
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body & Core - Week 8":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Split squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Hip thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor stretch 60s
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full-Body Maintenance - Week 9":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Inverted row (TRX) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Goblet squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility flow 60s
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full-Body Maintenance - Week 10":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Rowing pattern (seated cable row) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Goblet squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hip hinge to Romanian deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 60s
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full-Body Maintenance - Week 11":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Inverted row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Front squat (DB) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hip hinge to Romanian deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor stretch 60s
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Phase 3 Deload & Prep - Week 12":
        warmup:
          cardio 5m
        main straight_sets:
          DB bench press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Seated row 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Goblet squat 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip hinge 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 2x12 each side rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          full-body mobility 60s

notes:
- Avoid supine positions after week 16: ensure core and upper body work remains seated or standing; if any exercise requires support supine, replace with seated or standing variation.
- No maximal attempts; RPE targets designed to approximate submax effort.
- Maintain moderate intensity and form quality; tempo notated as need-based, focus on controlled movement and breathing.
- Abdominal exercises avoid Valsalva; exhale on exertion, brace lightly as tolerated.
- Hydration, frequent rest periods, and listening to pregnancy symptoms recommended; adjust volume if fatigue, nausea, or lightheadedness occur.
- Medical clearance: OB-approved; consult if any contraindication arises or baby/knee pain occurs.
